grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before processing the Funeral Expenses Payment claim

grants.description: Check your current benefit status with DWP
grants.purpose: To confirm you or your partner receive a qualifying benefit for Funeral Expenses Payment

grants.description: Share information about the deceased person
grants.purpose: To verify your relationship with the deceased and confirm eligibility for the payment

grants.description: Share funeral invoice or signed contract
grants.purpose: To assess the funeral costs and determine the payment amount

grants.description: Share information about the deceased's estate and other available funds
grants.purpose: To calculate the final payment amount, as any money from the estate will be deducted from the payment

grants.description: Share information about close relatives of the deceased
grants.purpose: To determine if a close relative in work or not on a qualifying benefit affects your eligibility

revocation.mechanism: Contact the Bereavement Service helpline on 0800 151 2012 or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Your claim will be cancelled if consent is revoked before a decision is made. If payment has already been made, you may need to repay it.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot declare estate information without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot declare close relative information without verification. Agent cannot appeal a decision on your behalf. Agent cannot provide false or misleading information about your relationship with the deceased.
